translation.title: Ketoprofen Gel
translation.efficacy: This medicine is used for pain relief and reduction of inflammation in degenerative arthritis (osteoarthritis), periarthritis of the shoulder, tendinitis and tenosynovitis, peritendinitis, humeral epicondylitis (such as tennis elbow), muscle pain, and swelling and pain after injury.
translation.usage: Depending on your symptoms, apply an appropriate amount to the affected area several times a day and rub it in gently so that it is absorbed well.
translation.caution: Do not use this medicine if you are hypersensitive to it or have photosensitivity (skin reactions triggered by sunlight), if you are hypersensitive to tiaprofenic acid, fenofibrate, bezafibrate, ciprofibrate or oxybenzone, if you have experienced an asthma attack caused by aspirin or other nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory analgesics, if you are 6 months pregnant or more, or for children under 15. Consult a doctor or pharmacist before use if you have bronchial asthma, or if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. While using this medicine and for 2 weeks after stopping it, avoid outdoor activities regardless of the weather, and when you go out, cover the area where the medicine was applied with clothing, sunglasses, a hat, sunscreen or similar so that it is not exposed to ultraviolet light. Do not use it in the eyes or on mucous membranes, on damaged skin or mucous membranes, on areas with eczema or a rash, or on athlete's foot or ringworm. Do not use an occlusive (airtight) dressing over it. Adverse reactions may occur - rarely shock-like symptoms (hypersensitivity-like symptoms such as hives, difficulty breathing or facial swelling) or an asthma attack (bubbling breath sounds, wheezing, difficulty breathing), and occasionally contact dermatitis with redness, rash, itching, blisters, sores, irritation or swelling, dry skin and pigmentation, or photosensitivity from ultraviolet light; if any of these occur, stop use immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Store at room temperature and keep out of reach of children.
